scripts.build: bun run build:linux-amd64 && bun run build:linux-arm64
scripts.build:linux-amd64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always)" -o dist/pupitred-linux-amd64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.build:linux-arm64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always)" -o dist/pupitred-linux-arm64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.release: bun run release:linux-amd64 && bun run release:linux-arm64
scripts.release:linux-amd64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 garble -literals -tiny build -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always) -X pupitre.studio/agent/internal/selfupdate.releasePublicKey=$PUPITRE_RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEY" -o dist/release/pupitred-linux-amd64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.release:linux-arm64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 garble -literals -tiny build -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always) -X pupitre.studio/agent/internal/selfupdate.releasePublicKey=$PUPITRE_RELEASE_PUBLIC_KEY" -o dist/release/pupitred-linux-arm64 ./cmd/pupitred
